title: Space Bound from a Head Envelope
statement: Let $M$ be a machine and $C$ a contract for $M$. For any data value $i$, configuration $d$, and work-tape index $j$, the number of distinct cells visited by tape $j$ from time zero through time $C$’s assigned time is at most the natural-number part of $C$’s upper bound plus one minus its lower bound for that tape; for an integer $z$, this natural-number part is $\\max(z,0)$.
replaced:
Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $C$ be a contract for $M$. For any
parameter $i$ and starting configuration $d$ whose state is the contract entry state and
which satisfies the contract precondition, and any work-tape index $j$, the number of
distinct cells visited by head $j$ from time $0$ through time $C.\mathrm{time}(i,d)$ is
at most $\max(C.\mathrm{hi}(i,d,j)+1-C.\mathrm{lo}(i,d,j),0)$.
